name: add_flashcard
description:
Use this tool to create a set of interactive flashcards for the user. 
The flashcards will be rendered as flippable cards in the chat where the user 
can click to reveal the answer, and navigate between cards.

Use this tool when the user asks for:
- Flashcards
- Study cards
- Vocabulary cards
- Term/definition pairs
- Key concept review cards
- Memorization aids

Each card has a front (question/term) and back (answer/definition).
Always include at least 3 cards. Keep front text concise and back text clear.

title.description: The title of the flashcard set (e.g., 'Chapter 5 Key Terms', 'Biology Vocabulary')

front.description: The front of the card (question, term, or prompt)

back.description: The back of the card (answer, definition, or explanation)
